design: Atomic Stata workflow blocks are reusable state transitions. Estimation is one block among many; preparation and post-estimation blocks receive the same retrieval priority.
variant_policy: A variant_group contains alternatives for the same atomic transition: select at most one complete compatible variant and never splice fragments. Distinct groups may be composed only in the actual producer-to-consumer order. Drop variants remain visible only for comparison.

dataset.finalize_keep_label_save.en: Finalize, label, and save analysis data

caller-declared eligibility, time-window, or required-variable rule
output_contract: one auditable restricted sample whose exclusion rule remains visible
incompatible_with: outcome-informed or source-inferred sample restriction

contracts.purpose_ko: 선언한 변수·집단·가중치에 대한 상관·분위수·집단 요약 결과를 만든다.
input_contract: fixed analysis sample
declared variables, groups, weights, and statistics
output_contract: one active or materialized descriptive result with declared statistics only
incompatible_with: undeclared statistic, weight, group, or observation unit

contracts.purpose_ko: 호환되는 활성 추정치에서 예측·검정·집계 등 하나의 사후추정 상태 전이를 수행한다.
input_contract: compatible active estimation state
caller-declared post-estimation target
output_contract: one command-specific post-estimation result or generated variable
incompatible_with: incompatible active estimate
manual coefficient or standard-error reconstruction

contracts.purpose_ko: 선언한 변수·표본·축 의미로 하나의 Stata graph를 만들고 활성 상태로 남긴다.
input_contract: active data or compatible post-estimation result
declared plot variables, sample, geometry, and axis meaning
output_contract: one active reproducible Stata graph; PDF export remains separate
incompatible_with: undeclared axis or sample choice
manual graph editing
bundled non-PDF final output

contracts.purpose_ko: 확정된 자료 상태를 선언한 delimited 또는 Excel 파일 계약으로 내보낸다.
input_contract: active finalized dataset
declared variable schema, destination, and overwrite role
output_contract: one declared external data file with auditable row and column schema
incompatible_with: undeclared overwrite
silent variable or observation filtering

contracts.purpose_ko: table·dtable·etable·collect 명령으로 하나의 명시된 collection 상태를 만든다.
input_contract: active data or compatible estimation result
declared rows, columns, statistics, model set, and Stata-version interface
output_contract: one populated and inspectable Stata collection; Excel export remains a separate transition
incompatible_with: legacy table syntax without a version contract
manual coefficient or standard-error bridge

contracts.purpose_ko: quietly/noisily처럼 결과 표시와 반환값 확인의 경계를 명시하는 참고용 진단 단위다.
input_contract: active data or an active result
a declared command whose display behavior is relevant
output_contract: bounded displayed or suppressed command output without changing the underlying analytic state
incompatible_with: using suppressed output as evidence that a required integrity or estimation check was performed

contracts.purpose_ko: 반복횡단면 또는 패널 DID의 자료 형태, 처리·집단·시간 정의와 목표 효과를 명시하는 참고용 추정 단위다.
input_contract: declared outcome, treatment, group and time variables
declared panel or repeated-cross-section form
pre-specified target effect and comparison design
output_contract: DID e-class result and declared postestimation state
incompatible_with: inferring treatment cohorts, comparison groups, or estimands from a guide example

contracts.purpose_ko: running variable, cutoff, bandwidth·추론 선택을 사용자가 선언할 때만 RD 명령 mechanics를 보여 주는 참고용 추정 단위다.
input_contract: declared outcome and running variable
declared cutoff
declared bandwidth, covariate, cluster, and graph choices when applicable
output_contract: bounded RD estimate, bandwidth result, or graph state
incompatible_with: choosing the cutoff, bandwidth, covariates, or identification design from a guide example

contracts.purpose_ko: PSU·가중치·층화 또는 복제 가중치가 이미 선언된 경우 svyset/svy mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: declared survey design variables and weight semantics
a stated subpopulation or estimation target when used
output_contract: active survey-design state or survey-adjusted command result
incompatible_with: treating an ordinary analytic weight as a survey design without a declared design

contracts.purpose_ko: 처리 단위·시점·패널 식별자·예측변수 집합이 선언된 경우 synth mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: declared unit and time identity
declared treated unit and treatment period
pre-treatment predictor and outcome history choices
output_contract: synthetic-control fit, weights, or declared saved result
incompatible_with: selecting treated units, treatment timing, predictors, or placebo design from a guide example

contracts.purpose_ko: 표본·x/y·통제·bin 규칙이 선언된 경우 binscatter mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 그림 단위다.
input_contract: declared analysis sample and x/y variables
declared bin count or compatible precomputed bin identifier when used
declared controls or group comparison when used
output_contract: active binned-scatter graph or named bin identifier
incompatible_with: choosing bin count, residualization controls, groups, or display scale from a guide example

contracts.purpose_ko: 결측 규칙과 MI 등록 범위가 선언된 경우 missing()/mi mechanics를 점검하는 참고용 무결성 단위다.
input_contract: declared missing-value semantics
declared imputation scope and variables when MI is used
output_contract: visible missingness diagnostic or declared MI data-management state
incompatible_with: silently redefining substantive missing values or imputing variables not declared by the analysis plan

contracts.purpose_ko: 정렬되고 선언된 시간 또는 패널 시간이 있을 때 lag·lead·difference operator의 mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: declared tsset or xtset-compatible time ordering
declared variable and boundary treatment
output_contract: derived time-series expression or an estimation expression tied to the declared time state
incompatible_with: using time operators before a valid temporal declaration or silently bridging gaps

contracts.purpose_ko: 그룹 키·정렬·그룹 내 연산의 의미가 선언된 경우 by/bysort mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 준비 단위다.
input_contract: active data
declared group key and required ordering
declared within-group operation
output_contract: bounded group-wise result or updated values
incompatible_with: treating incidental current sort order as the required analytic ordering

contracts.purpose_ko: 이미 정의된 값의 표시 형식만 명시적으로 바꾸는 참고용 메타데이터 단위다.
input_contract: active variable with unchanged substantive meaning
declared display format
output_contract: updated display metadata without changing stored values
incompatible_with: using display formats to conceal a unit, scale, or stored-value change

contracts.purpose_ko: 변수 복제·저장형식 변경·압축의 정보 보존 조건을 명시하는 참고용 메타데이터 단위다.
input_contract: active data
declared variable meaning and required precision
declared overwrite or clone policy
output_contract: declared storage representation with preserved or explicitly changed metadata
incompatible_with: compression or recasting that loses identifiers, precision, labels, or value semantics

contracts.purpose_ko: 임시 파일·변수·이름이 현재 블록 안에서만 소비될 때 그 수명과 연결을 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: active Stata session
declared immediate consumer for each temporary object
output_contract: session-scoped temporary object bound to its declared consumer
incompatible_with: persisting a temporary name as a project interface or relying on it after its producing session

contracts.purpose_ko: 현재 자료에서 변수목록을 점검·해석하고 즉시 소비할 때 ds/unab mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: active dataset
declared variable-selection rule or explicit varlist
output_contract: resolved local varlist for an immediate declared consumer
incompatible_with: silently expanding a varlist into an undeclared outcome, treatment, or control specification

contracts.purpose_ko: 검정 family·목표 계수·재표본 계획이 선언된 경우 rwolf2 mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 강건성 단위다.
input_contract: declared model-to-target mapping
declared testing family and resampling plan
declared cluster or strata when used
output_contract: adjusted p-values tied to declared targets
incompatible_with: defining the hypothesis family, target coefficients, or resampling structure from a guide example

contracts.purpose_ko: 반복 횟수·난수 시드·재배정 또는 시뮬레이션 설계가 선언된 경우 simulate/permute mechanics를 보조하는 참고용 단위다.
input_contract: declared statistic or command
declared repetitions, seed, and assignment or strata design
output_contract: declared simulation or permutation result state
incompatible_with: using a guide default repetition count, seed, assignment process, or strata as a research decision

contracts.purpose_ko: 이미 승인된 파일 경로와 실행 순서가 있을 때 do/include mechanics만 보조하는 참고용 실행 단위다.
input_contract: declared file path
user-approved execution order and path context
output_contract: bounded execution of the declared file without inventing workflow order
incompatible_with: discovering files, changing paths, probing dependencies, or inventing execution order
